area: Testbed audit: one shared arena layout

find.report_claim: four on-demand reports (arena_tile_report, bot_nav_preview via it, nav_authoring_report, nav_plan_report/_nav_grid) each recomputed size/1.0/-size/2 and the world-to-cell conversion
find.live_evidence: grep found the same size/origin math at four sites and two copies of the floor-based cell conversion; a level-size edit would need four synchronized changes
find.consumer_evidence: after extraction, _arena_layout() returns (40, 1.0, (-20,0,-20)) and _to_cell maps spawn (0,8) -> (20,28) and pickup (0,-6) -> (20,14), the same cells every report uses

read: tests covering tile/nav/authoring/agent reports (all still green after the refactor)
mutation probe: hardcoding width=40 in _nav_grid while the report still said 20
killed: leaving four copies: a future arena resize would desynchronise the reports
changing tile solid cells to use floor-only conversion: that would alter the shipped tile map for no reason; arena_tile_report keeps its floor/ceil cover bounds

accepting the first mutation result: hardcoding width passed the initial tests because they only compared the report's stated width, not the grid's real width — the assertion was strengthened to check grid.width
analyze.survivor: one _arena_layout() helper plus _to_cell(), used by all four reports while preserving every existing value

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py adds _arena_layout() and _to_cell() and routes arena_tile_report, _nav_grid, nav_plan_report and nav_authoring_report through them; tests/test_keystone_arena_layout_mechanics.py (4 tests) pins the layout, endpoint conversion, resized-arena propagation and sim isolation; README tree names the new test

shooter.failing_first: all 4 new tests failed with AttributeError before the helpers existed
shooter.own_test_bugs: two corrections: size 20 with cell 1 means width 20, not 10; and the first mutation (hardcoded grid width) passed because the test checked only the report's stated width — strengthened to assert grid.width == layout width
shooter.mutation: hardcoding width=40 in _nav_grid now fails the resized-arena test; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 2ee56a80a26abe67bd7b756a3dd3d5981b7d68de11d3dcc28c871f1)
shooter.codebase_map: regenerated after the new helpers and test module
